acceptance: Measure peak JVM memory for the default local Spark SF0.01 run.
Either set a bounded default driver memory for local mode, or fail early with a message naming driver_memory when the default would exceed the budget.
A TPC-H SF0.01 generate,load,power run on local Spark completes under make heavy-run without extra options.
context: Found while landing the Spark create_connection fix. Local only, no cloud. Verification rubric: measurement before/after, smoke run recorded in the PR body, focused tests, comment-policy, CI green.
description: A TPC-H SF0.01 power run on local Spark with default settings was killed by the heavy-run memory watchdog: the JVM used 8.56 GiB against the 8 GiB budget. The run only passed with --platform-option driver_memory=3g. Users and agents hit a kill with no hint about the option.
